description: unfold plugin hooks. PreToolUse on the edit tools carries the write-intent trigger to the moment it fires: the turn a session is about to write to a repository is the turn its unit's chart has to be open. The script stays silent outside the repositories whose charts this plugin routes to, and emits once per session so the reminder lands before the first write rather than beside every one. Best-effort throughout: any internal fault exits 0 and injects nothing.
